brand.name: Wayseeker
brand.tagline: A cabinet of tools for creative work

hero.title: What are you settling for?
hero.lede: {{count}} habits that creative work settles for. Each one is filed beside the tool that replaces it, with an honest caution on the label.

cabinet.title: The cabinet
cabinet.lede: Five columns, one for each stage of the work. {{count}} labelled drawers; pull any one to read its label.
cabinet.noMatches: No drawer matches. Try a habit, like “prompt” or “motion”.

plan.title: Write a prescription
plan.lede: One drawer from each column, chosen to share a direction. Swap any line that doesn't fit and the rest stays put. Copy it as Markdown and hand it to your agent.
plan.clipboardPending: The clipboard request is still waiting for the browser. Check for a permission prompt, or copy the text manually.
plan.copyFailed: The clipboard is unavailable. Select and copy the text below, or try again.
plan.blank: Five lines, one per column, waiting to be written.
plan.label: Prescription

titles.ai: Taste for your agent, starting from {{name}}

plan.copyFallbackHint: Select the text below and copy it, or try again.
plan.undoHint: Available until you leave or reload this page.
plan.rewritten: New prescription written. Your previous prescription can be restored.
plan.basis: Starts with {{name}}. Suggestions favor related directions; check each label for fit.

detail.clipboardPending: The browser has not finished copying. If a clipboard permission prompt is open, respond to it to continue.
detail.copyFailed: The clipboard is unavailable. Copy the label text below, or try again.
detail.imageFailed: The image could not be prepared. Try again, or copy the label text.
detail.manualHint: Select and copy this text using your browser or keyboard.

footer.meta: {{count}} tools, filed by hand, in English and Chinese.

notFound.title: This drawer is empty
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.
